heading: Gentle Ultrasonic Teeth Cleaning
blockquote: Support your dog’s oral hygiene with a calm, non-invasive cleaning treatment.
body:
Our ultrasonic teeth-cleaning service uses specialist technology to help reduce plaque, tartar and bacteria without the noise, vibration or brushing action associated with a conventional electric toothbrush.

The treatment is designed to be gentle and comfortable, making it suitable for many dogs who tolerate their mouths being handled. Regular appointments can help improve breath and support cleaner teeth and healthier-looking gums. This is a cosmetic oral-hygiene service rather than veterinary dental treatment, and we will always recommend speaking to your vet if we identify signs of pain, disease or a problem requiring clinical care.
